core_meaning.primary_meaning: Layth corresponds to the Arabic form ليث and is glossed in this record as “Lion.” The record associates the form with root ل ي ث (l-y-th). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Layth corresponds to the Arabic form ليث (Arabic root ل ي ث (l-y-th); لَيْث (Layth)). Its core sense is lion. Layth is Arabic لَيْث (Layth) 'lion', from the root ل ي ث (l-y-th); it is a well-documented male given name borne by Layth ibn Sa'd. The source record was an 8-key stub with no data. Same name as lais and laith.

persian.name: لیث
persian.long_meaning: Layth (لیث) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن لیث، شیر است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: ليث
